    """Mirror a 3x3 input tile across both axes to form a 9x9 grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * h):

        row = []
        for c in range(3 * w):
            tile_c = c // w
            inner_c = c % w
            src_c = inner_c if tile_c == 1 else (w - 1 - inner_c if tile_c == 0 else inner_c)
            row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])
        out.append(row)
    return out
